question: Should OpenClaw ship this dashboard plugin enabled by default with an unauthenticated approved-widget asset route and confirmation-gated bridge for agent-authored browser code?
rationale: The source defects are mechanically repairable, but accepting a permanent agent-authored code execution boundary and making it a default bundled product surface requires maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Ship after hardening
options.body: Accept the architecture only after every finding is fixed, conflicts are resolved, upgrade behavior is proven, and the complete custom-widget lifecycle has exact-head evidence.

options.title: Ship built-ins only
options.body: Land durable workspaces and trusted built-in widgets while deferring the unauthenticated route and agent-authored custom-widget bridge.

options.title: Keep experimental
options.body: Retain custom widgets but make the dashboard plugin disabled by default and explicitly experimental until broader security and upgrade evidence exists.

recommendation.title: Ship after hardening
recommendation.body: Accept the architecture only after every finding is fixed, conflicts are resolved, upgrade behavior is proven, and the complete custom-widget lifecycle has exact-head evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete integrated and hardened this branch and owns the adjacent merged plugin-tab implementation history, making them the best available owner for the final product/security choice.
